fusions.name: Heard Bleeding
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. You dive at a target up to 6 tiles away, dealing 20 dark damage, rising to 1.5 times that from the full 6 tiles. It deals 15% more damage for each affliction on the target (max 45%).

fusions.name: Clatter Sonar
fusions.desc: Rattles your scales in a narrow cone 5 tiles ahead of you, dealing 11 resonating damage to everything in it, stunning it for 1 second and leaving it [Leaden] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Hang Curled
fusions.desc: Veils you for 8 seconds and restores 10 health. Enemies notice you 60% later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Dusk-Hardened
fusions.desc: At night, your armour rises by 12%. Your dodge chance is 4% higher at all times.
